source_reason.description: Why this source was chosen when the default Helm > Kubernetes > Compose priority was overridden.

build_targets.description: Components built from this repository. Consumed by Phase 3 and UPDATE mode.

public_service.description: Service key that owns the public entry, when known.

resource_hints.description: Per-service container resource limits from repo evidence (README system requirements, upstream compose). Sealos ladder values. Phase 4 passes each entry to the converter via --resource-hint.

bootstrap_mode.description: Account bootstrap classification evidence gathered during discovery (first-user signup, deployer-supplied bootstrap, runtime-generated bootstrap, or optional root reconciliation).
